The '''tech center''' of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] was a chamber deep in the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscanti]] structure. Staffed by members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Technical division/Legends|Technical division]], the machinery in this chamber controlled electrical, water, and air circulation throughout the Temple. Smaller, satellite facilities such as repair centers and switch rooms were located throughout the Temple, specifically concentrated in the south west quadrant of the complex.

==History==
Established within the Jedi Temple during the renovations pre-[[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], the tech center of the complex serviced the entire Temple's electrical, water, and atmospheric controls. The chamber granted access to a number of service tunnels and the main power generators for the complex.<ref name="TCT" />

During a [[Incident at the Jedi Temple|series of robberies and vandalism]] in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], specialist [[Miro Daroon]] operated the tech center, and was therefore responsible for making sure all of the bugs installed by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Xanatos]] were undone. Unable to purge them using conventional methods, Daroon was forced to shut down all of the Temple's systems for twelve minutes in order to right all of the problems. However, Xanatos had rigged the Temple to explode when the systems restarted, thus completely ruining the Order. Master [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] manage to prevent this by retrieving the power source of the planned explosion, the stolen [[Healing Crystals of Fire]], from the fusion furnace and ended the crisis.<ref name="TCT" />

Over a decade later, Padawans [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Tru Veld/Legends|Tru Veld]] met each other when they were scavenging for a part in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]] that the tech center was short on. While Veld had been looking for the part to assist Master [[Ali-Alann]] in repairing his new nursery [[Droid/Legends|droid]], Skywalker had been looking to use it for himself. Feeling guilty, Skywalker gave Veld the device and they both made their way back to the Temple.<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Way of the Apprentice">''[[Jedi Quest: The Way of the Apprentice]]''</ref>

At the end of the three year-long conflict known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], in his alter ego [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], ordered the [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|seizure]] of the Jedi Temple and the slaughter of its occupants. Over-run by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], the Temple sustained massive amounts of damage due to a large fire that spread throughout its halls. When the fire finally died down, the Temple was abandoned, aside from a small occupying force of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="ROTS" />

Not long after its abandonment ex-Jedi [[Ferus Olin]] and the street boy [[Trever Flume]] infiltrated the Temple to discover and destroy the rumored [[Storage floor|Jedi Prison]]. Making their way in through the damaged [[Tower of Reconciliation/Legends|Tower of Reconciliation]], the pair found their way into the Droid Repair Center, a satellite chamber of the tech center. Combing through the rubble in search of the old service tunnel entrance, the two intruders were detected by a squad of troopers guarding the Temple. Quickly diving beneath of burnt husks of dead droids the pair remained hidden and, due to the timely scurrying of a startled [[meer rat]], the stormtroopers dismissed the disturbance and wandered off. Olin and Flume then quickly searched the Temple, deduced that there was no prison at all, and fled in search of the elusive Jedi Master [[Fy-Tor-Ana]].<ref name="LJU">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Underworld]]''</ref>

Later, the pair returned to the Temple with Master Ana and discovered that [[High Inquisitor]] [[Malorum]] intended to destroy the Temple by overloading the main power core. Rushing to the chamber Olin quickly defused the bomb by turning down the power and draining the core of its energy.<ref name="LJU" /> The Inquisitor's plot sabotaged, the Temple would survive for another two decades, throughout most of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and the withdrawal of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] from Coruscant.<ref name="BRS">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron]]''</ref>

==Layout==
A circular room, the tech center of the Jedi Temple contained all of the major operating systems controls for the entire complex, with smaller satellite facilities used to maintain services in certain areas. Located on the same level as the [[Halls of Healing]], the Tech Center was attached the Temple's main service hallways and also had an access way into the main reactor.<ref name="TCT" />

Along the curving walls were [[Datascreen/Legends|datascreens]] that constantly flashed updates reported from each of the Temple's systems. Monitored by the tech specialist on duty, the chamber was vital to the operation of the complex. The room had four doors stemming from it: the main access way, the entry to the service hall network, a heavy [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] door which led into the central core, and the well access gate. Beyond the door marked "Fusion Furnace" was a small, circular chamber ringed by a catwalk. At the center of the catwalk was an opening and a ladder which descended ten stories into the Temple's infrastructure. At the bottom of the ladder, the walls were covered with compartments and switches, all labeled according to use.<ref name="TCT" /> Also off this chamber was the white room which held the sublight generator and its control computer.<ref name="LJU" />

Near the base of the Tower of Reconciliation was a small droid repair center. Here, Jedi technicians repaired and updated the many droids that operated within the complex. A [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] shelf ran along one wall, holding parts and tools; while powered-down [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]] lined another. A service tunnel with a gaping entrance was located here; droids were transported down the white, low-ceiling, rounded corridor to other areas throughout the Temple.<ref name="LJU" />

After the Temple was abandoned, Ferus Olin explored this room, looking for the service hallway that went to the accommodation sector. The shelves and the droids had all fused from the heat of blaster fire, while the stone ceiling had been blown away, letting in rain water. Olin was able to clear the path to the service hall, narrowly escaping a patrol of stormtroopers.<ref name="LJU" />
